subject: Acme vendor intake & PO flow — kickoff and line-item guidance
messages:
From: Samira Gutierrez <samira.gutierrez@acme-corp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Procurement Ops <procure@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor intake & PO kickoff for Redwood engagement

Hi Rachel + Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We're ready to move forward with vendor setup on our side for the upcoming usage of Redwood Dedicated capacity. Before we lock dates with our finance team, can you confirm:

- Which vendor forms you need completed (W-9, vendor intake, terms acceptance)?
- Whether Acme needs to issue a PO before the first invoice (we usually do, but we want to confirm lead times).
- Line-item format you prefer on the PO (one consolidated line vs. split by model/term/support).

I've attached our standard vendor intake so you can tell us if anything there conflicts with Redwood's requirements. Matt in finance is looped on procure@acme-corp.com for any follow-ups.

Prefer to get a kickoff call on next Wed/Thu — happy to propose times once you confirm what we need to prepare.

Thanks,
Samira G.
Head of Vendor Programs
Acme Corporation
Attachment: acme_vendor_intake_form.pdf (fillable)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Gutierrez <samira.gutierrez@acme-corp.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & PO kickoff for Redwood engagement

Hi Samira — great to hear and thanks for sending the intake form.

Short answers up front:
- Required paperwork: completed vendor intake, W-9 (U.S. vendors) or W-8 if non-US, and a copy of the signed SOW/ordering doc. For Redwood Private/Dedicated we also ask for a primary billing contact and remit address.
- PO timing: Acme's PO number will be required to process invoices. Typical issuance timeline on our side is 7–10 business days from the point when vendor setup is complete with accounting and W-9 received. If you need expedited handling we can request priority review (may require AP confirmation).
- Line-item guidance: we recommend one primary line for the platform/subscription and separate lines for ancillary items. Suggested columns on the PO: item_description | sku | qty | unit_price | term_start | term_end | support_fee | one-time_setup | tax. See attached Redwood PO template and an example line-item breakdown.

Proposed next steps:
1) You fill the vendor intake and attach a W-9 (or W-8).
2) We'll run vendor setup in our accounting system and confirm the remit address/contact (we'll assign an internal vendor ID).
3) Once vendor is in the system, Redwood Finance issues an internal acknowledgement and you provide the PO number that your AP will use when invoicing.

Can we do a 30-minute kickoff on Wed 18 Feb at 10:00 AM PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and draft an agenda (vendor setup owners, required fields on invoices, PO number placement, sample invoice walkthrough).

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_po_template.xlsx

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Acme PO/vendor setup — owner assignments + timeline

Team — forwarding the Acme intake thread. Quick coordination so we can meet the proposed kickoff on Wed 18 Feb.

Action items / proposed owners:
- Marissa: lead on pricing confirmation and construct the suggested line-item breakdown (match SKU names to the Redwood products in the PO template). Deliverable: example invoice line-item CSV by Mon 16 Feb.
- Karthik: own the customer-facing kickoff and attend Wed 18 Feb call; you'll field any commercial questions (discounts, term alignment).
- Dev: partner with AP to complete vendor onboarding in NetSuite once we have the filled intake and W-9. Expect ~2 hrs of setup work; target completion by Tue 17 Feb EOD.
- Laura: finance escalation path and expedite request if Acme needs a faster PO issuance.

Notes for line-item formatting (for Marissa):
- Consolidated subscription line okay for recurring platform fees, but break out one-time setup and optional support as separate lines.
- Use 6-digit SKU prefix (RW-) then model or capacity descriptor (e.g., RW-DED-32G-1YR).
- Include term_start and term_end fields; AP relies on these to apply proration.

Timeline:
- Mon 16 Feb: Marissa sends sample line items
- Tue 17 Feb: Dev completes vendor setup (pending W-9)
- Wed 18 Feb 10:00 AM PT: Kickoff call with Acme

I'll draft the meeting agenda and send calendar invite once Samira confirms. Reply if any conflicts or if you want to flip owners.

Thanks — Rachel

Rachel — confirmed. Attached is the completed intake and a scanned W-9. Thanks for the clear checklist — that helps.

We can do Wed 18 Feb 10:00 AM PT (that's our Samira — note timezone). Meeting invite accepted.

Quick clarifications before the call:
- Acme prefers consolidated subscription line + separate support line. We will include your suggested SKU format when we issue the PO.
- We may request a one-week acceleration on PO issuance; please let us know if Laura will be available to approve an expedite.

Attachments: acme_completed_vendor_intake.pdf, acme_w9.pdf

See you on the call — Samira
